verdict.rationale: Flagsmith has a public GitHub repository (github.com/Flagsmith/flagsmith), and its docs say the complete platform can be self-hosted and run locally with Docker, which strongly implies the source is readable. However, no evidence names the license or confirms it is an OSI-approved open license, and no evidence says which components (core vs. enterprise features) are open. Missing for 10: explicit license identification (e.g., BSD/MIT/Apache), clarity on open-core vs. proprietary feature split, independent corroboration of license terms.
